standard: National Disaster Management Authority Flood Guidelines

STAGE_1_WATCH.action: Continuous telemetry monitoring and EOC notification

STAGE_2_WARNING.threshold: Inflow > 10,000 m3/s or minor structural seepage
STAGE_2_WARNING.action: Pre-position SDRF and notify downstream villages

STAGE_3_EMERGENCY.threshold: Spillway capacity exceeded or partial breach
STAGE_3_EMERGENCY.action: Sound sirens, enforce Route R02 priority evacuation

STAGE_4_CATASTROPHIC.action: Full emergency deployment, high-ground shelter activation

STAGE_5_RECOVERY.threshold: Water receded below high danger mark
STAGE_5_RECOVERY.action: Search and rescue, infrastructure damage assessment
